AU_SP_ASX200.rationale: ASX is an official primary exchange and exposes an All ASX Listed Companies CSV plus an Industry field. Retrieved official evidence does not bind that directory Industry field to a named/versioned source-native taxonomy. ASX separately documents GICS use for sector indices, while the directory page also discloses LSEG/Morningstar data; no silent assumption that the directory Industry field is GICS is allowed.

BR_IBRX100.rationale: B3 officially publishes its sector classification and says the query base is updated weekly. Bounded official research found the public query/hub and classification criteria, but did not establish a reproducible bulk constituent/reference download carrying the classification for the cohort.

CN_CSI300.rationale: CSI publishes a coded multi-level industry-classification standard and official CSI 300 sector information. Official index methodology says the CSI data-service platform publishes index data daily, but bounded evidence did not verify a bulk row-level constituent/reference route that includes the source-native industry code/name for the exact Frozen cohort.

IN_NIFTY50.rationale: NSE Indices officially defines a coded four-tier classification and the NIFTY 50 page exposes an Index Constituent download plus sectoral distribution. Current retrieved evidence did not verify the exact current bulk constituent schema/identifier fields needed to prove deterministic source-security to Source_WS_ID linkage for all 45 Frozen rows without relying on unstated assumptions.

JP_N225.rationale: The official Nikkei 225 component page is a single reproducible current page (updated 2026-09-25) listing component security codes under named industries and sectors. The retrieved official source exposes classification names but no source-native sector/industry classification code; using a locally invented code is prohibited.

TW_TW50.source_native_candidate: ICB within FTSE TWSE Taiwan Index Series
TW_TW50.rationale: TWSE/FTSE Russell official rules explicitly use coded ICB Industry Groups for the Taiwan index series. Bounded official evidence did not verify a current row-level bulk constituent/reference route exposing ICB code/name for every exact Frozen Taiwan 50 security.

US_SP400.source_native_candidate: SEC Standard Industrial Classification via EDGAR bulk submissions
US_SP400.rationale: SEC is an official registry. EDGAR documents a nightly bulk submissions ZIP, ticker/exchange association data, public SIC codes, and the 2026 SIC taxonomy. Frozen WS_ID uses ticker+Primary_MIC for these U.S. rows; retrieved evidence does not yet establish an auditable governed mapping from SEC exchange strings/CIK identity to the exact MIC-qualified Source_WS_ID for all 368 rows.
